$comment: The supply-chain gate's exceptions (gates/supply-chain, F4) for this package's own dev tools: a licence off the gate's allowlist, or an install script, each with why it is accepted. A project keeps its own list here; the gate reads it unless --allowlist names another file.

licenceExceptions.caniuse-lite: CC-BY-4.0: browser-support data, no code; pulled in by the test toolchain only
licenceExceptions.lightningcss*: MPL-2.0: file-level copyleft, used unmodified as a build tool by vitest; never shipped
licenceExceptions.glob: BlueOak-1.0.0: a permissive licence (Blue Oak Model License), not yet on the SPDX allowlist above
licenceExceptions.lru-cache: BlueOak-1.0.0: a permissive licence (Blue Oak Model License), not yet on the SPDX allowlist above
licenceExceptions.minimatch: BlueOak-1.0.0: a permissive licence (Blue Oak Model License), not yet on the SPDX allowlist above
licenceExceptions.minipass: BlueOak-1.0.0: a permissive licence (Blue Oak Model License), not yet on the SPDX allowlist above
licenceExceptions.path-scurry: BlueOak-1.0.0: a permissive licence (Blue Oak Model License), not yet on the SPDX allowlist above

installScripts.fsevents: macOS file watcher with a native build; optional, never installed on Windows or Linux
installScripts.@parcel/watcher: a native file watcher in the test toolchain; its install script picks the prebuilt binary for the platform
installScripts.unrs-resolver: the module resolver jest uses; its install script picks the prebuilt binary for the platform
